classification.difficultyReason: Use Pythagoras on the supplied right triangle with unit radius and explicitly given tangent and secant lengths to complete one identity.

spec.description: Unit circle, positive-x tangent AT, dashed secant OT, unit radius, angle theta and right angle at A. Ordinary marks are black under the house palette. No shading.
spec.mathematics: OA=1; AT is perpendicular to OA; OT passes through a first-quadrant point on the unit circle.
spec.answerVisibility: All supplied geometry remains visible; the completed identity appears only in answers.

answer.worked:
By Pythagoras in the right triangle, with $OA=1$:
$$\begin{align*}OA^2+AT^2&=OT^2\\1+\tan^2\theta&=\sec^2\theta.\end{align*}$$
